fields.name: ospf.at.auth_data_len
fields.description: The length in octets of the Authentication Trailer (AT) including both the 16-octet fixed header and the variable length message digest

fields.name: ospf.at.sa_id
fields.description: That maps to the authentication algorithm and the secret key used to create the message digest

fields.name: ospf.at.crypto_seq_nbr
fields.description: Increasing sequence number that is used to guard against replay attacks

fields.name: ospf.at.auth_data
fields.description: Variable data that is carrying the digest for the protocol packet and optional LLS data block

fields.name: ospf.grace.period
fields.description: The number of seconds neighbors should advertise the router as fully adjacent

fields.name: ospf.grace.reason
fields.description: The reason the router is restarting

fields.name: ospf.grace.ip
fields.description: The IP address of the interface originating this LSA
